run_nms_masks: run non-maximum suppression on segmentation masks given predicted probabilities and binary masks
run_generic_nms: run generic non-maximum suppression using a pairwise IoU matrix and detection scores
run_generic_nms_cpu: run generic non-maximum suppression on CPU using numpy-based pairwise IoU filtering
test_generic_nms_cuda: test generic NMS with CUDA backend when torch_generic_nms is available
test_generic_nms_triton_fallback: test generic NMS falling back to triton implementation when torch_generic_nms is unavailable
